name: Biodiesel Alternative
description:
Trees are not the only source of power for the renewable enjoyer. You can continue expanding your wood production, but you can also skip the Charcoal business entirely. Instead of refining crude oil into Diesel, you can produce Biodiesel from renewable biological oils.

Biodiesel generally provides less energy per bucket than Diesel, which is the tradeoff for using renewable resources.

There are several ways to produce the required Seed Oil or Fish Oil:

CropsNH: Grow high-stat Canola or Oilberries. Canola is generally preferred due to its higher throughput than most other seeds.

Regular farming: Automate crops such as Peanuts or other seed-producing crops to obtain Seed Oil without using CropsNH.

Fishing: Catch Cod or other fish to obtain Fish Oil.

Another good option is to farm Goldfish with CropsNH, which yields at least twice as much oil per extraction operation.

[note]Crop stats improve the output of CropsNH plants, making them worthwhile if you choose that route, but they are by no means required. Whether you use CropsNH, conventional farming, or automated fishing, all three paths ultimately produce biological oil that can be refined into Biodiesel.[/note]
